This represents the number of broadside weapons, the basic armament, your ship has available. The type of weapon is more or less irrelevant. Mundane ballistae or cannons or—depending on your setting—magic guns or photonic blasters are all, mechanically, the same: Volley.

Note

It’s worth mentioning that Volley technically represents the weapons on only one side of the ship; see @UUID[Compendium.ship-stats-card.rules.JournalEntry.3852e1007a5eea10.JournalEntryPage.0c27ad20a332e2dc]{Range and Weapon Facing} for more details.

When attacking with your Volley, you expend Energy dice up to the number of weapons available: your Volley stat.

Ammunition (ammo) or charge for your Volley weapons is always assumed to be plentiful. By default, each weapon deals 1 point of damage. Modifications to the Volley can increase this damage or add a special effect—for instance, incendiary rounds. See @UUID[Compendium.ship-stats-card.rules.JournalEntry.61e1e70906654345]{Modifications} for further details on options for ammo or weapons.

Prime weaponry is something else. You can only have one Prime weapon—unless you have the Weapons platform modification (see @UUID[Compendium.ship-stats-card.rules.JournalEntry.61e1e70906654345]{Modifications}). The Prime stat represents the number of ammo or charge for the weapon you have. In other words, the Prime stat is the maximum number of times this weapon can be used in a battle.

In general, the Prime weapon deals 5 damage if at least one of the attack dice remains after the enemy’s defense.
